budget_items.topic: Right of first refusal - 1083 Northfield Road
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair reported the sale offer on the chapter 61 forestry parcel subject to the town's right of first refusal.

The agent said the fee schedule sits in both the town charter and the bylaw so the commission cannot change it without going through the select board and town meeting, and proposed moving it into the bylaw alone; she noted fees are currently collected only on notices of intent, not on administrative approvals, amendments, certificates of compliance or extensions.
Mary recalled a prior cost estimate for printing the wetlands buffer-zone flyer for inclusion in a town tax mailing.
Andrea and Mike discussed the license fee to screen the documentary for a community audience versus an individual ticket, reading a figure off the distributor's website.

budget_items.topic: Grant match requirement / conservation land funding
budget_items.what_was_said: Mary said grants the commission applies for require a match, historically covered partly by tree-harvesting revenue on conservation land, and cautioned that revenue source needs a replacement plan before it is reduced.

budget_items.topic: Hollis Road residence upkeep and renovation
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said ongoing heating and electricity costs are being incurred to maintain the currently-unused Hollis Road residence, and she is checking with the town manager on the prevailing-wage threshold for work to make it habitable.

budget_items.topic: 50 Pine Grove Road amended order filing fee
budget_items.what_was_said: There was uncertainty on the call whether an application fee had already been paid for the amended order request, given the applicant will have to refile.

decisions.decision: The applicant for the 50 Pine Grove Road amended order agreed to withdraw the request and refile it with proper abutter and DEP notification rather than continue without a duly noticed public hearing.

The commission agreed by informal poll to let the applicant file for a full certificate of compliance on the FRA portion of 260 Fitchburg Road, while withholding a certificate for the Tango Construction portion until its restoration work is finished.
The commission decided to take no formal action on reported off-trail snowmobile use near the Lane property for now, and to monitor and coordinate with the snowmobile club if it recurs.

The conservation agent will meet with town counsel about moving the commission's fee schedule out of the town charter and into its own bylaw, and about charging fees for administrative items not currently billed.
The agent will proceed with planning a small Earth Day event on April 22 at TC Pacios with local environmental organizations despite the short notice.
The stormwater committee set a public information session with Weston and Samson at the library the next evening and plans to reduce meeting frequency afterward, ahead of town meeting.

minutes.summary: This was a routine Conservation Commission hearing night: the board worked through several new and continued wetlands filings, including a large proposed townhouse subdivision off New Westminster Road, a deck replacement, a rooftop-solar/battery storage project, and a lakefront cottage rebuild, most resolved with negative determinations, approvals with conditions, or continuances for site walks once snow clears. The commission also declined to exercise its right of first refusal on a chapter 61 forestry property that is being sold, had an applicant withdraw an improperly-noticed amended order request, discussed updating its fee schedule and the future of the town-owned Hollis Road residence, and appointed a new liaison to the Open Space Committee.

what_happened.line: Commission voted not to exercise the town's right of first refusal on a chapter 61 forestry parcel at 1083 Northfield Road, letting the pending sale proceed.
An applicant withdrew a request to amend wetlands conditions at 50 Pine Grove Road after the hearing was found improperly noticed, and will refile with proper notice.
The conservation agent will consult town counsel about moving the fee schedule out of the town charter and into a commission bylaw, and about billing for items not currently charged.
A proposed 20-unit townhouse subdivision's common driveway on New Westminster Road was continued to April 1 while other wetlands filings were approved with conditions or continued for site walks.
Members noted that grants requiring a local match have relied on tree-harvesting revenue from conservation land, and said a replacement funding source needs planning if that revenue drops.

why_it_matters: Declining the right of first refusal means the town gives up its option to buy or steer the future use of the chapter 61 land before it changes private hands.
Moving the fee schedule into a standalone bylaw and billing for administrative approvals, amendments, and certificates could raise the cost of routine wetlands filings for residents.
The revenue the commission uses to match conservation grants comes from harvesting on town conservation land, a source members flagged as needing a backup plan.
